pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Ten years in real-time graphics and the web platform, end to end: the shader that renders it, the budget that keeps it fast, and the pipeline that ships it.

children: I’m a creative developer. That means I live in the seam between design and engineering — the demos that look impossible, the interfaces that feel alive, and the tools that make building them faster. Ten years in, mostly real-time graphics and the web platform.

I care about the whole path, not just the pretty frame: the shader that renders it, the memory budget that keeps it at 60fps, and the build pipeline that ships it to a phone. A prototype that can’t survive production was never finished — it was a screenshot.

Before going independent I built rendering tech at a games studio and interactive work at a creative agency. Now I take on a handful of build-heavy projects a year, and I keep a few open-source libraries alive between them.
